scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Must be a bonafide resident of Haryana
Must be an orphan child of an ex‑serviceman
Must not be receiving any financial assistance from any department of the Haryana Government
Must be below 21 years of age
Must submit annual survival verification proof each year in April
Must provide details of the orphan child with date of birth as issued by the Unit Record Office of the Ex‑servicemen
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month (with an annual increase of ₹400) is provided to eligible orphan children of ex‑servicemen.
documents_required: Date of birth certificate issued by the Unit Record Office of the Ex‑servicemen
